// Generated by explorer-proto/src/emit.ts from trace.json (discovered actions and locators) and
// scenarios.json PILOT-01 (declared assertions). Do not edit by hand; re-run explore + emit instead.
// No pw.skipIfNoLicense(): nothing here depends on a licensed feature.

import {expect, test} from '@mattermost/playwright-lib';

import {closeGuardedSessions, openGuardedSession} from '../src/session';

test.afterEach(closeGuardedSessions);

/**
 * @objective Open Info panel follows the newly selected channel after a sidebar channel switch (MX-05).
 * Seed-bound text checks use expect.soft so a negative-control seed reports every failing declared string
 * while navigation and visibility stay hard assertions.
 */
test(
    'PILOT-01 open Info panel follows the newly selected channel after a sidebar channel switch',
    {tag: ['@channels', '@channel_info', '@explorer_pilot']},
    async ({pw}) => {
        const {page, channelsPage} = await openGuardedSession(pw);
        const info = page.getByRole('region', {name: 'Info', exact: true});

        // # Go to /qa-team/channels/qa-sandbox (exploration root, state s72745cc9)
        await channelsPage.goto('qa-team', 'qa-sandbox');
        await channelsPage.centerView.header.toBeVisible();

        // # Click button "View Info" (discovered: trace #3, region "Info" appeared)
        await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'View Info', exact: true}).click();
        await expect(info).toBeVisible(); // smoke: observed transition #3 (region "Info" appeared)

        // * Checkpoint pre_switch: declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01 expected_outcome.pre_switch)
        await expect(info).toBeVisible(); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)
        await expect.soft(info).toContainText('Sandbox purpose alpha-7f3c'); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)
        await expect.soft(info).toContainText('Sandbox header alpha-7f3c'); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)

        // # Click link "release planning public channel" (discovered: trace #8, URL path changed to /qa-team/channels/release-planning)
        await page.getByRole('link', {name: 'release planning public channel', exact: true}).click();

        // * Checkpoint post_switch: declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01 expected_outcome.post_switch)
        await expect(page).toHaveURL((url) => url.pathname === '/qa-team/channels/release-planning'); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)
        await expect(info).toBeVisible(); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)
        await expect(page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Close Info', exact: true})).toBeVisible(); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)
        await expect.soft(info).toContainText('Release Planning'); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)
        await expect.soft(info).toContainText('Release purpose bravo-91d2'); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)
        await expect.soft(info).toContainText('Release header bravo-91d2'); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)
        await expect.soft(info).toContainText('release-planning'); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)
        await expect.soft(info).not.toContainText('Sandbox purpose alpha-7f3c'); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)
        await expect.soft(info).not.toContainText('Sandbox header alpha-7f3c'); // declared (scenarios.json PILOT-01)
    },
);
